articles.title: French diplomat 'intimidated' in Iran by suspected security agents: source
articles.description: France's deputy chief of mission in Tehran was this month subjected to "intimidation by individuals claiming to belong to the Iranian security forces"on Tuesday. The incident, the second involving French diplomats in Tehran in less than four months, highlight…
articles.content: Paris: France's deputy chief of mission in Tehran was this month subjected to "intimidation by individuals claiming to belong to the Iranian security forces", a diplomatic source told AFP on Tuesday.… [+2008 chars]
